description_en: Used for intelligent recognition scenarios. Requires uploading the OSS address of shopping videos. The platform creates an asynchronous recognition task and immediately returns a task_id. Notifications are sent via webhook, and the results need to be actively retrieved through the query API
description_zh: 用于智能识别场景， 需要上传购物视频 OSS 地址，平台创建异步识别任务并立即返回task_id, 通过webhook 通知，需要主动查询接口获取结果
kebab_example: aliyun agentretailvision recognize-order --order-unique-id ORDER_001 --video-urls https://oss.example.com/video1.mp4 --device-id DEVICE_001 --candidate-items 535c3daaadgaf5382db49a90969bc2d --callback-url https://example.com/callback --region cn-hangzhou
name: RecognizeOrder

parameters.help_en: Unique idempotent ID of the business party, unique within the same business party
parameters.help_zh: 业务方唯一幂等ID，同一业务方下唯一
parameters.name: order_unique_id

parameters.help_en: List of shopping video OSS addresses (currently only one is supported)
parameters.help_zh: 购物视频OSS地址列表（目前只支持一个）
parameters.name: video_urls

parameters.help_en: List of candidate items. It is recommended to pass platform_item_id
parameters.name: candidate_items

parameters.help_en: Callback URL for this task. If not provided, the registered default address is used
parameters.help_zh: 本次任务回调地址；不传则使用已注册默认地址
parameters.name: callback_url
